cumulativeAxioms.title: Lapidary Inversion Principle
cumulativeAxioms.statement: Textual legibility does not require intrinsic pigment contrast; it can emerge dynamically as a function of raking incident light and cast relief umbras.

cumulativeAxioms.title: Spatial Suture through Directional Shadow
cumulativeAxioms.statement: Cast shadows act as non-local semantic ligatures across fractured layout planes, satisfying Gestalt closure across fissures up to 80px.

cumulativeAxioms.title: Non-Newtonian Typographic Viscosity
cumulativeAxioms.statement: Governing tracking and glyph deformation via fluid surface tension allows rapid navigation to condense words into Bouma silhouettes with chromatic fringing, relaxing into classical editorial proportion at rest.

cumulativeAxioms.title: Acoustic Nodal Purity
cumulativeAxioms.statement: Typographic stem stability is a function of resonant acoustic harmonics. Sweeping into integer harmonic nodes arrests vibration, restoring 100% standing wave sharpness.

cumulativeAxioms.title: Atmospheric Capillary Bleed
cumulativeAxioms.statement: Digital letterforms behave as breathing ecological membranes when coupled with micro-climatic relative humidity, expanding stroke weight up to 45% and feathering ink into permanent organic stains upon evaporation.
